title: Turning tracking back on shows the count as it stands now
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ASITSTANDS-01) is active and untracked at {Location-A}; it held 4 in {Bin-A} and 3 in {Bin-B} when tracking was turned off, and {Bin-A} was then changed to 1 while it was untracked.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is on.
  3. Read the Inventory section.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Read the {Part-A} row's Total Qty cell.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The bins show the quantities as they stand now: {Bin-A} 1 and {Bin-B} 3, not the 4 and 3 held when tracking was turned off.
  • Step 5: Total Qty reads "4 Available" (1 + 3 = 4), not 7.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R6 and §4 Key Decisions (Turning tracking back on shows the count as it stands), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.6 (Switch back on) and tracking-note-5, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
